what: What lessons 41 and 42 cost on 18 November 2026, in us-east-1: each machine's hours, from the launch time and end time AWS reports, times its on-demand price. Worked out by hand from those times, not printed by a lesson's script. The L40S machine has two rows: the lessons' first runs, and their second stages later the same day, timed from the start of the one job to the end of the other. Between and after them it did other work, which is not counted here.

machines.for: lesson 41 on one card, then lesson 42
the second stages: lesson 41's bigger sizes, then lesson 42's sending from four processes
